pre_generation_checks: Match screenplay version to actual cut and timed dialogue; never import absent lines
Review Brazilian vocabulary, collocations, pronouns, register, names, relationships, negation and deadlines
Translate complete same-character sense units before distributing original subtitle windows
Resolve avoidable textual and continuity errors before voice generation
Estimate speaking duration before synthesis; preserve meaning before shortening; no forced excessive acceleration

feedback_lessons.rule: Correct pronunciation does not establish adequate emotional intensity; urgent calls require scene-supported urgency and projection
Natural full-thought phrasing and pauses are useful contextual examples; never replace every formal Portuguese construction globally
Ensure quiet inner monologue remains intelligible over music; determine mix changes locally rather than applying uniform gain
A quoted word alone cannot identify a take when multiple occurrences or A/B versions exist
Positive feedback supports only its stated dimension and identified excerpt; no comment is not acceptance

post_review_actions.ordinary_improvement: Record evidence and apply to future ungenerated material; retain delivered episode
post_review_actions.critical_understanding_or_delivery_failu: Prepare the smallest affected segment scope, cache reuse and estimated incremental cost for user decision; no automatic full-series rerun

review_sampling.purpose: Find reusable weaknesses to improve future output
